source: Judged on 2026-10-24 (TRA-485) from the work's own pitch / article, which names the artist. A hint is only the question put to MusicBrainz: the run credits a work when MusicBrainz finds its exact title, the credit confirms the hint and the year agrees. Left out on purpose: project:selected-ambient-works-85-92 (artist:richard-d-james lists it, and artist:aphex-twin has no member/alias edge the audit follows) and project:tri-repetae (artist:autechre is not in the cache, so its two members, which list it, would trip homonym-release-links): crediting them needs those artist edges first.
